preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 100 and 1 <= G <= 100 and 1 <= B <= 100 and 1 <= M <= 100 for R, G, B, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, G, B, and M are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in r) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in g) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b) for r, g, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All potion amounts are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(r) == R and len(g) == G and len(b) == B for r, g, b, R, G, B in zip(r_lists, g_lists, b_lists, R_vals, G_vals, B_vals))
preconditions.description: The number of potions in each list matches the corresponding count R, G, B.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(ans, int) for ans in answers)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a single integer.

postconditions.expression: all(min_max_val(R, G, B, M, r, g, b) == ans for R, G, B, M, r, g, b, ans in zip(R_vals, G_vals, B_vals, M_vals, r_lists, g_lists, b_lists, answers))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum possible value of the maximum potion amount achievable by applying at most M halving operations distributed among the three color groups.
